schema_notes: Catalog of bundled audio assets. The plugin's Audio view reads this to render cards. Each click → pre-fills a chat prompt that tells the AI to import the asset into the user's project using execute_python + loco helpers.

assets.name: SFX_UI_Click
assets.description: Short bright click, great for button press feedback.

assets.name: SFX_UI_Hover
assets.description: Soft mid tone for button hover / focus.

assets.name: SFX_UI_Confirm
assets.description: Two-tone positive chime for confirmations / menu advances.

assets.name: SFX_Coin
assets.description: Classic coin ding. Pairs well with add_pickup_template.

assets.name: SFX_LevelUp
assets.description: Ascending 4-note arpeggio for level-up or achievement moments.

assets.name: SFX_Hit
assets.description: Short punchy impact, generic melee / projectile hit.

assets.name: SFX_Damage
assets.description: Wide-band hit for character damage / ouch feedback. Pairs with add_damage_template.

assets.name: SFX_Death
assets.description: Descending sweep for player death / fail state.

assets.name: SFX_Explosion
assets.description: Low boom with noise tail for explosions / destruction.

assets.name: Music_MenuLoop
assets.description: 4-second C-major ambient loop, good for menus and title screens. Seamless loop.

license_notes: All placeholder assets are procedurally synthesized (sine waves, filtered noise) and released CC0 / Public Domain.
These are intentionally minimal stand-ins. Production games should replace with curated or licensed SFX.
Replace this catalog by curating assets from: freesound.org (CC licenses), opengameart.org (CC / CC-BY), kenney.nl (CC0).
